name: Longleaf Landscape Stewardship Fund
summary: Grants to restore, enhance and conserve longleaf pine and bottomland forest across the historical longleaf range in the southeastern United States, including building local organisations' capacity to lead restoration.

geography.label: Historical longleaf pine range, southeastern United States

reporting: Grantees report on project metrics chosen from the fund's list in NFWF's Easygrants system.

status.quote: Longleaf Landscape Stewardship Fund 2026 Request for Proposals - CLOSED

deadline.quote: Full Proposal Due Date January 29, 2026, 11:59 PM, Eastern Time

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include non-profit 501(c) organizations, state government agencies, local governments, municipal governments, Tribal Governments and Organizations, and educational institutions.

geography.quote: expands, enhances and accelerates longleaf pine ecosystem restoration across longleaf pine's historical range throughout the southeastern United States

access.quote: All application materials must be submitted online through National Fish and Wildlife Foundation's Easygrants system.

amount.quote: Grant awards are expected to range from $250,000 to $2,000,000.

co_finance_required.quote: Matching funds are encouraged but not required.

reporting.quote: the Longleaf Landscape Stewardship Fund has a list of metrics in Easygrants for full proposal applicants to choose from for reporting
